autoreply_save_failed: &cRule ''{0}'' could not be saved; the change was rolled back. See the server log.
spam_caps: &cPlease reduce the amount of uppercase letters.
player_only: This command can only be used by players.
log_autoreply_save_failed: Could not save config/autoreply.yml after changing auto-reply rule '{RULE}'; the change has been rolled back
log_autoreply_file_overwritten: Configuration file {FILE} was changed or removed on disk while the server was running, but an auto-reply command also changed this configuration in memory. The in-memory configuration was saved, so the changes made to the file while the server ran were overwritten.
log_channel_format_missing_both: UltiChat: {FILE} gives channel '{CHANNEL}' the format "{FORMAT}", which this version applies, so that channel's chat lines show no sender name and no message text. To fix it, add {player} or {displayname}, and add {message} to the format, or remove the format to use the global chat format (UltiKits/UltiChat#16).
log_channel_format_missing_sender: UltiChat: {FILE} gives channel '{CHANNEL}' the format "{FORMAT}", which this version applies, so that channel's chat lines show no sender name. To fix it, add {player} or {displayname} to the format, or remove the format to use the global chat format (UltiKits/UltiChat#16).
log_channel_format_missing_message: UltiChat: {FILE} gives channel '{CHANNEL}' the format "{FORMAT}", which this version applies, so that channel's chat lines show no message text. To fix it, add {message} to the format, or remove the format to use the global chat format (UltiKits/UltiChat#16).
log_duplicate_window_applied: UltiChat: {FILE} sets 'anti-spam.duplicate-window' to {SECONDS} seconds, and this version applies it: a repeated message now counts as a duplicate only while its earlier copies are at most {SECONDS} seconds old. Before this version the setting was ignored and repeats counted however far apart they were sent, so duplicate detection is now more permissive than before the upgrade. To restore the previous behaviour exactly, set it to {DEFAULT} (no time limit, the new default) and run /uchat reload (UltiKits/UltiChat#14).
removed_key_warning: UltiChat: {FILE} still contains '{KEY}', which this version no longer reads. {REASON} Delete the key from the file to silence this warning.
removed_key_reason_mute_duration: Nothing ever used it: players were never muted automatically, whatever it said, and a spam trip still refuses only the offending message (UltiKits/UltiChat#15). Automatic muting is requested as a feature in UltiKits/UltiChat#30.
config_announcement_chat_messages:
Welcome! Type /help for assistance.
Please follow server rules!
log_config_text_save_failed: UltiChat: could not save {FILE} after writing its built-in text in the server language ({ERROR}). The new text is used until the server stops; the next start tries again.
